_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 1: jump table, scripted ship, four-cell burst, item box maker ($8000-$8218). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: BANK 1 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8000`
regions.description: `JMP $803C`: the scripted ship. Called by the player's handler (bank 3 `$8CEF`, far call `01 FF 7F`) in place of the whole frame whenever slot 0's field `$07E8` is non-zero; **A = `$07E8`**, which is the mode, 1-3.

regions.name: BANK 1 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8003`
regions.description: `JMP $812A`: the four-cell burst with tile base 0 and attribute mask `$AA`. Callers: bank 2 `$8817` (far call `01 02 80`) and bank 5 `$A28D` (the seal zones' sparks).

regions.name: BANK 1 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8006`
regions.description: `JMP $812E`: the same burst with **A = the tile base and Y = the attribute mask** from the caller; bank 2 `$8660` (far call `01 05 80`).

regions.name: BANK 1 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8009`
regions.description: `JMP $8176`: the item-box maker. Caller: the explosion handler, bank 6 `$97AE` (far call `01 08 80`).

regions.name: BANK 1 JUMP TABLE: slot `$800C`
regions.description: `JMP $82B5`: the handler of type `$4F`, `It`, the last boss. Caller: the bank 6 stub `$9605` (far call `01 0B 80`), which the type `$4F` dispatch entry reaches.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3?
regions.description: `CMP #$03 / BEQ $809F`: mode 3 is the explosion scene (below). Modes 1 and 2 are the same arc and fall through. Mode 1 is set by the gate's door code (bank 5 `$A15C`: the ship is pushed through into the corridor); mode 2 by the cleared gate's ship entrance (bank 7 `$F4BE`, `$F4B7`).

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): gravity
regions.description: `LDA #$18 / JSR $C09C`: the y spring `$CD12` with acceleration 24/256 toward the target `$0668`, which the setter put far below the screen (`$F8` in mode 1, `$FB` in mode 2): a constant pull down, so the ship follows a thrown arc.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): move without drawing
regions.description: `$0548` is saved, set to 0 (a metasprite that draws nothing) and `JSR $C08D` (move and draw) runs, then `$0548` comes back: only the movement is wanted here, the picture is drawn at the end. **Carry out of the move = the ship has left the screen.**

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): off the screen: leave
regions.description: `$A0` |= 3 and return: the warp-style exit (`$EB18`; with `$A4` = 4, set by the gate's code, there is no flash and the corridor loads). RUN: mode 1 reaches this 86 passes after the push.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): rising or falling?
regions.description: `$05D8` (the y speed) negative goes to `$808A`.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): falling
regions.description: A := y; Y := the mode. Mode 1 goes to `$807B`. Mode 2: y under `$96` just draws (`$8087`).

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 2 reaches the ground: start mode 3
regions.description: y >= `$96`: `$07E8` := 3, the tick `$0638` := 0, and `BEQ $809F` (always taken) enters the explosion scene in the same pass.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 1, falling
regions.description: y under `$6F` just draws. From y `$6F` down the **sprite attribute `$0560` gets bit 5 (behind the background)** and the ship is drawn: it falls behind the scenery. RUN: bit set at y 111, frame 62 after the push.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): draw
regions.description: `JMP $C090`: draw the ship and return.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): rising
regions.description: Mode 1 draws as it is. Mode 2: while y >= `$6F` it draws as it is, and **above `$6F` the attribute `$0560` is cleared** (bit 5 off: in front of the background again) before it draws. RUN: the entrance starts behind the background (attribute `$20`, set by bank 7 `$F4E5`) and comes out in front at y 110, frame 22.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: the tick and the end
regions.description: Draw (`$C090`) and `INC $0638`. **When the tick wraps to 0 the scene is over: `$07E8` := 0 and the facing `$0668` := 4 (down)**, and the player's own handler takes the ship back. That is 255 passes of mode 3.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: the last tick
regions.description: Ticks under `$E0` go on; exactly `$E0` jumps to `$8112` (the last burst and the icon); between `$E1` and `$FF` nothing happens but the draw and the count.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: an explosion every 4th tick
regions.description: `$0638 AND 3` = 0: `$19` := `$80` (x), `$18` := `$70` (y), the box `$15` = `$14` = `$3F`, `JSR $C120` (`$FB12`): one type-8 explosion near the middle of the screen, with sound `$22`. RUN: 63 explosions in the scene, at x 112-160, y 82-141.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: every 16th tick the explosion is a big one
regions.description: `$0638 AND $0F` = 0 and the slot Y that `$FB12` returned is under `$18`, still of type 8 (the object loop has not run on it yet): **its type becomes 7**, the 42-frame player-side explosion. RUN: ticks 16, 32 ... 240, 15 of them.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: tick `$80`
regions.description: From tick `$80` on, four bursts: **at `$80` the four-cell burst at x `$50`, y `$80`** (`$80F7` sets `$19` := Y, `$18` := A and jumps to `$812A`).

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: tick `$A0`
regions.description: Burst at x `$90`, y `$40`.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: tick `$C0`
regions.description: Burst at x `$90`, y `$80`; any other tick returns.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): mode 3: tick `$E0`, the last burst and the icon
regions.description: Burst at x `$50`, y `$40` (`JSR $80F7`), then two inline strings of two tiles each:

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): the icon, top row
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `02 21 AF 5C 5E`: tiles `$5C`, `$5E` at PPU `$21AF` (row 13, columns 15-16);

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): the icon, bottom row
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `02 21 CF 5D 5F`: tiles `$5D`, `$5F` at `$21CF`. **Tiles `$5C-$5F` are where an item's icon is built (bank 2 `$81B2`), so this puts the picture of the reward item (x 120-135, y 104-119: the middle of the screen, where the gate's reward box stands) into the background.** RUN: the tiles land at those cells; which icon they show depends on what the icon uploader put in the tiles.

regions.name: SCRIPTED SHIP (bank 1 `$803C`, slot 0 while `$07E8` is non-zero): return
regions.description: `RTS` (the `JSR $80F7` and the burst's own `RTS` end here).

regions.name: FOUR-CELL BURST (bank 1 `$812A` / `$812E`): default arguments
regions.description: `LDA #$00 / LDY #$AA`: tile base 0, attribute mask `$AA` (palette 2 in every quadrant), then on into `$812E`.

regions.name: FOUR-CELL BURST (bank 1 `$812A` / `$812E`): set-up
regions.description: `$16` := A (the tile base), `$17` := Y (the attribute mask), `$15` := 0 (the cell class written for each cell, `$FADE`: 0 = floor), Y := 0 into the table.

regions.name: FOUR-CELL BURST (bank 1 `$812A` / `$812E`): next record or end
regions.description: `LDA $8169,Y / CMP #$FF`: the table at `$8169`, three bytes a record, ends with `$FF`.

regions.name: FOUR-CELL BURST (bank 1 `$812A` / `$812E`): one cell
regions.description: The record is [dx][dy][dtile]: **x (`$19`) += dx, y (`$18`) += dy, tile `$16` += dtile** (the tile is not restored, so it accumulates), then `JSR $C117` (`$FA96`, break a block: a type-`$30` blast at the cell, the 2 x 2 tiles redrawn through `$D865`, the cell's class set to `$15`); x and y are restored, Y += 3. **Four cells, a 32 x 32 block: (0,0), (16,0), (0,16), (16,16) with the tile numbers 1, 5, 9, 13.** With a tile number whose low two bits are not 0 `$D865` takes the four tiles from the table at `$D8E0`: **1 = `F9 FA F7 F6`, 5 = `F0 F9 F5 F7`, 9 = `F8 F5 F9 FA`, 13 = `F6 F8 F0 F9`** (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). RUN from the labyrinth state: the 4 x 4 tiles at the burst show exactly these rows and four blasts appear.

regions.name: Four-cell burst: 4 x [dx][dy][dtile] + $FF
regions.description: `00 00 01 | 10 00 04 | 00 10 04 | 10 10 04 | FF`: x offset, y offset, tile increment; the terminator is read as the first byte of a record (`$8139`). The earlier generated claims `$816A` and `$816B` were this table's second and third columns found by the reads' offsets, and the trace had decoded `$8169` as a `BRK`.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the kill's weight
regions.description: Y = the dead enemy's type (kept in `$0740`); `$823D[Y]` is its weight, 0 = it does not count (return). `$10` := the weight.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the counter and the step
regions.description: `$42` (the step 0-7) into Y, `$43` (the kill counter) into A.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): count up
regions.description: A += 1 up to the weight times; **the moment A equals the threshold `$8219[$42]` (50, 80, 100, 140, 180, 220, 230, 0 = 256) the drop is made**, `BEQ $8190`; otherwise the counter is stored (`$818D`) and the routine returns - leftover weight is lost at a threshold.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): no drop
regions.description: `STA $43`; `$818F` is the `RTS`.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): a drop: the counter
regions.description: `$43` := the threshold value reached.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the box's cell, y
regions.description: The explosion's y is saved on the stack and capped at `$A0` (from `$B0`);

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): y, labyrinth only
regions.description: `BIT $30 / BVS`: in a corridor (`$30` bit 6) no lower limit; in the labyrinth y is raised to at least `$20`;

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): y snapped to a cell
regions.description: y AND `$F0` OR 8 = the cell's centre row; stored in the object and in `$07B8` (the cell y).

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the cell's x
regions.description: x is saved on the stack and clamped to `$20-$E0`;

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): x snapped to a cell
regions.description: x AND `$F0` OR 8, stored in the object and in `$07D0` (the cell x).

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the cell class
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with `06 05 80`: bank 6 slot `$8006` (`$8435`, the class under the object), A = the class.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): is the cell free?
regions.description: Y := class; the saved x and y come back; `$822D[class]` non-zero (blocked) takes the counter back by one (`DEC $43`) and returns - **the next kill tries again**. In a corridor every class looks up as 0 (bank 6 `$8435`), so a drop is never blocked there.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the explosion becomes a box
regions.description: `INC $0788,X`: the explosion handler's variant (bank 6 `$9842`) makes it the item-box object, type `$32`. Y := the step `$42`; **the contents `$8221[$42]`** (`14 15 16 14 14 15 15 00`); non-zero goes to `$8200`.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): step 8: the rotating item
regions.description: The step whose contents are 0 takes the next of four from `$8229[$44 AND 3]` (`15 0C 0C 0B`; `$44` counts up): `$0B` (+20 Eraser uses) only if `$04AE` bit 6 is set - without the Eraser it is replaced by `$0C`.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the item, the step
regions.description: `$0680,X` := the item id; `$42` += 1; **a counter that ended at 0 (threshold 256) makes `$42` := 0**, so the cycle starts again after the 8th.

regions.name: ITEM BOX MAKER (bank 1 `$8176`, from the explosion handler): the box's state
regions.description: Collision flags `$0578` := `$C2`; `$05D8` := `$FE` and `$0668` := `$FE` (non-zero `$0668` is the box's OPENED flag, bank 2 `$854B`, so a dropped box is collected by touching it; what `$05D8` means for a drop was not read - it is the PPU address high byte for a shop item). `RTS`.
